name: ShanFa Admin Live Mobile App Blueprint
purpose: Autonomous production build specification for Shanfa Group Ecommerce Admin Companion & Real-Time Customer Tracking Mobile Application. Built with 100% live database connectivity and zero dummy data.

theme.style: Minimal Pure White (Apple Human Interface Guidelines & Material 3)

events.name: cart-added
events.description: Triggered in real-time when any online visitor adds an item to cart

payload.title: Item Added to Cart
payload.message: A customer added {productName} ({qty}x) to their cart

events.name: checkout-entered
events.description: Triggered in real-time when any online customer opens the checkout/cart page

payload.title: Customer at Checkout
payload.message: Customer with {itemCount} items ({totalAmount} {currency}) is on checkout

events.name: new-order
events.description: Triggered in real-time when a customer completes payment or places a COD/Stripe/Tabby/Tamara order

database_apis.purpose: Fetches real-time financial stats, status counts, and latest 10 orders directly from DB

queryParams.status: ALL | PENDING | PROCESSING | SHIPPED | DELIVERED | CANCELLED

database_apis.purpose: Retrieves live orders from MongoDB with full customer info, item details, shipping address, and phone
Directly updates the order fulfillment status in MongoDB database
Fetches all products with images, price, stock, active status, VAT option, delivery option
1-tap mobile toggle to instantly activate or deactivate a product in the live database

app_screens.name: Dashboard
features: Live Connection Status Pill (Green when Pusher WebSocket is connected)
Financial metrics cards: Today's Revenue, Today's Orders, Total Orders
Interactive Status Badges (Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered)
Live Visitor Activity Ticker (Shows recent cart-added, checkout-entered, new-order events in real-time)
Recent 5 orders list with tap to open order modal
Pull-to-refresh to fetch latest DB metrics instantly

app_screens.name: Orders
features: Status filter tabs (All, Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, Cancelled)
Real-time Search by customer name, phone number, or order ID
Full order details card: Customer name, phone, address, city, country, payment method, payment status, item quantity and prices
1-tap status selector bottom sheet (Updates database immediately without reloading)

app_screens.name: Products
features: Product catalog directly from MongoDB
Search products by title or SKU
Display product image, price, stock count, and badges (Free Delivery, VAT Exempt)
1-tap Switch toggle to instantly toggle isActive true/false in DB

app_screens.name: Live Events
features: Live chronological event stream
Customer cart additions (with item names and prices)
Checkout entries (with cart item counts and currency totals)
Completed purchases (celebratory card with payment method)
Clear feed or filter by event type

app_screens.name: Settings
features: API Base URL input field (defaults to https://shanafaglobal.com or custom domain/IP)
Admin Account details display
Audio and Haptic alerts toggle (Sound On/Off, Vibration On/Off)
Pusher reconnect button
Secure Log Out (clears local token and resets state)

build_and_deployment.engine: Expo Application Services (EAS) Cloud Build / React Native
build_and_deployment.output_format: Standalone Android APK (.apk) ready to install on any Android phone directly
steps: 1. Open terminal inside mobile-app directory: cd mobile-app
3. Install EAS CLI globally if not present: npm install -g eas-cli
4. Log in to Expo account: npx eas login
5. Run cloud build for APK: npx eas build -p android --profile preview
6. Wait 3-5 minutes: Google/Expo cloud automatically compiles the native APK
7. Click the provided download link or scan the QR code directly on your mobile device to download and install the app!
